description: A basic application that allows users to create, edit, delete, and view notes.
vision: To provide a straightforward and user-friendly note-taking solution for individuals who want to manage their daily tasks or ideas efficiently.

features.name: Note Creation
features.description: Users can create new notes with titles and text content.

features.name: Note Editing
features.description: Users can edit the title and content of existing notes.

features.name: Note Deletion
features.description: Users can delete individual notes or clear all notes at once.

features.name: Note Viewing
features.description: Users can view their notes, which are organized by date of creation.

user_stories.i_want: to create a new note about my homework assignments so that I can keep track of them.
to edit an existing meeting reminder note to include additional details such as the location so that I do not forget important information during the day.
to delete my old business plan notes so that I can organize my current projects better.
acceptance_criteria: Can select and remove specific notes
All notes are cleared with a single action

user_stories.i_want: to view all of my notes in chronological order so that I can easily find what I need.
acceptance_criteria: Notes list is ordered by date

non_functional_requirements.performance: The app should load and display notes quickly, with a response time of less than 2 seconds for any operation.
non_functional_requirements.security: Data encryption must be used to protect sensitive information. User data should only be accessible by the authorized user.
non_functional_requirements.scalability: The application should handle up to 1000 notes without performance degradation.
non_functional_requirements.availability: 99% availability with no more than one hour of downtime per month.

constraints: Must use a lightweight database for storage
User interface must be intuitive and easy to navigate
assumptions: Application will not require frequent updates or maintenance
